text:
carla: quick heads-up — I'm doing a changelog pass for next deploy. Need help tightening relnotes and fixing some inline SDK snippets for embeddings/migration guides.
omar: which pages should I scan for dead links?
carla: start with guides/embeddings.md, sdk/js/embeddings.md, and the draft changelog at /changelog/2026-03. Also the migration note for ‘embed streaming’ needs clearer before/after examples.
maria: I can handle SDK snippets (js/python). Any test failures flagged already?
carla: main trouble: snippets still show streaming usage for embeddings. We should show the non-streaming pattern + a tiny helper wrapper. Also call out token accounting diff in the migration note.
omar: scanning now — found 3 broken anchors and one absolute marketplace link we should canonicalize to docs.redwood.ai.
ryan: FYI — put a short caveat for Dedicated customers about routing fallback; sales has reported a support ticket where fallback hit a 503 during high load. cc @sales
carla: good call. Add a Known issues bullet: "Routing fallback may trigger 503s for some beta model variants; recommend pinning to stable model on Dedicated."
maria: I'll draft the JS/Python before/after snippets and tests. planning to open a PR in ~10m.
carla: please include an explicit diff example in the changelog — people scan for code changes more than prose. e.g. show a tiny code block labeled BEFORE and AFTER.
maria: agree. sample I'll add: 
```js
// BEFORE
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'text-embed-001', input })
// AFTER
await client.embeddings.create({ model: 'text-embed-001', input, stream: false })
```
carla: perfect. also add a note about token-length behavior when disabling streaming.
omar: fixed the links — replaced marketplace absolute URLs with canonical docs links; pushed one commit to my branch.
docs-bot: New PR created: #5421 by maria — https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5421
carla: I will do a quick sanity pass on the changelog text and then merge if CI is green. If no objections by EOD I'll ship.
ryan: :thumbsup:
maria: LGTM, watching CI for snippet failures (will revert quickly if anything flakey).
carla: thanks everyone. small follow-up: add a cross-ref to the Optimize guide for batching recommendations — helpful for customers switching off streaming.
omar: added the cross-ref in my follow-up commit.
carla: great. I'll include the Known issues bullet, the explicit BEFORE/AFTER snippet, and the dedicated caveat in the final relnotes.
carla: tagging this thread resolved once merged.
